verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair interaction axis for any user-facing app, including an authenticator, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only touch gestures (swipe, tap, drag, scan QR) and plain username text search, none of which are natural-language commands. There is no voice, assistant or LLM-driven control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
